title: Senior Social Media Associate
description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join

The Channel Communications team at Airbnb is responsible for driving positive conversation and buzz about Airbnb via social media, influencers and more, as well as maintaining and protecting our brand reputation across social media channels. The team is expanding its India presence, combining always-on reputation protection with channel growth, listening and insights for one of Airbnb's fastest-growing markets.

The Difference You Will Make

The Social Rapid Response team is looking for a Senior Social Media Associate who will be responsible for protecting and defending the Airbnb story on social media. This role pairs core Social Rapid Response coverage with support for Airbnb's India social presence, partnering closely with the India social lead on listening, insights, publishing and campaign engagement.

The ideal candidate is a social native with experience in social listening and responding rapidly to escalating issues and crises. We’re looking for someone who is detailed and solution-oriented, is comfortable moving at a fast pace and working with little manager supervision, has strong communication and interpersonal skills.

 

A Typical Day

  • Monitor emergent issues across social media channels
  • Proactively highlight and/or provide status updates on issues surfacing online to Lead(s)
  • Own day-to-day social listening for the India market, including competitive and cultural conversation tracking
  • Turn listening into insight; synthesize themes into regular recaps and ad hoc deep dives for comms, marketing and regional stakeholders
  • Provide publishing support for @airbnbindia, including scheduling, copy QA and channel hygiene
  • Support community engagement on @airbnbindia campaign moments - comment response, sentiment tracking and surfacing engagement-worthy UGC
  • Support S&D workstreams as they surface on social
  • Ability to work cross functionally on communications initiatives involving Community Support and Trust operations, Policy, Regulatory, Corporate and Crisis Management
  • Draft copy and publish content across different channels
  • Key POC for publishing, engaging, accepting brand collabs and taking down posts as and when needed across brand social channels during APAC hours, in collaboration with marketing and comms social teams
  • Assist with developing playbooks and guidance on best practice
  • Assist with measuring campaign/project effectiveness
  • Support local APAC teams with reputational flagging and management
  • Support the team with the management of sensitive, high risk reactive & proactive communications on Airbnb’s social media channels 
  • Appropriately support on urgent posts, ‘handoffs’ and various escalations
  • Monitor queues and provide guidance to the team as needed
  • Highlight gaps in workflows for continuous improvement
  • Gather and analyze data for reporting, deep dives, performance insights and quality
  • Support upskilling and onboarding of new teammates
  • Support with writing response strategies
  • Support driving initiatives and projects with regional/global impacts
  • Support as a team representative during high-stakes and/or global events (ie. Olympics)
  • Assist Lead when out of office, as needed

Your Expertise

  • 4+ years of experience working on social media related projects in a fast-paced environment
  • Multi-channel issues and crisis management experience
  • Working knowledge of the India social landscape and cultural conversation
  • Hands-on experience publishing and engaging on Instagram, including Reels and Stories
  • Experience translating social listening data into written insights for non-social stakeholders
  • Experience working on cross functional projects with multiple stakeholders
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Strong verbal communications and interpersonal skills
  • Strong social investigation skills
  • Skilled in operational excellence and continuous improvement
  • Experience with Sprinklr required, or other social media monitoring tools is a plus
  • Experience using internal CRM tools to aid investigation, is a plus
  • Language proficiency in English required, proficiency in Hindi and/or other Indian languages strongly preferred
  • Bachelor’s Degree, or equivalent work experience
  • Passion for Airbnb and the mission of the company 
  • Ability to work weekend days and public holidays required, as well as evening shifts when needed. Please note that this role requires you to work Sunday to Thursday OR Tuesday to Saturday for 9 hours per day (including a 1 hour break) anywhere between 7am to 8pm (in your local timezone). Your schedule can change to meet business needs and, where possible, we will take your availability into consideration.

description:

Adyen provides payments, data, and financial products in a single solution for customers like Meta, Uber, H&M, and Microsoft - making us the financial technology platform of choice. At Adyen, everything we do is engineered for ambition.

title: ISV Success Manager
location: Bellevue, Washington; Chicago, Illinois; New York, New York; San Francisco, California; Seattle, Washington; Washington, DC
description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

The ISV Ecosystem team sits within the Okta Products and Technology organization and is focused on expanding our breadth and depth of SaaS integrations across both Okta Workforce and Auth0 product areas, a C-level priority for the company. Our team ensures SaaS ISVs (independent software vendors) have the knowledge, tools, and incentives to build integrations that extend our core product functionality. We are driving the formation and adoption of new identity standards focused on building an interconnected and secure AI ecosystem. Okta’s ecosystem is a core differentiator, and developing a scalable approach to ecosystem development will be a critical driver of our next stage of growth.

As an ISV Success Manager, you will nurture ISV relationships to expand the Okta Integration Network. Balancing internal strategy with external technical guidance, you will support ISVs through their integration journey: from discovery and build support to roadmap influence. You will act as a bridge between integrators and cross-functional stakeholders (Product, Engineering, Product Marketing, Partnerships, etc.) to improve the integrator experience and shape partner programs. Your success will directly impact ISV satisfaction, ecosystem growth, and platform adoption across Okta and Auth0.

The ideal candidate combines strong communication, analytical, and technical skills to influence ISV roadmaps, identify integration requirements, and assist through technical roadblocks. You must thrive in cross-functional environments and treat ISVs as true customers, solving strategic business and technical challenges to scale the Okta ecosystem. We look for a deep interest in identity and security, and the ability to evangelize Okta’s value to both builders and buyers. As the voice of Okta, you will also represent us at industry events and drive thought leadership.

Responsibilities:

  • Establish thought leadership on identity, identity standards, and “enterprise readiness” requirements for SaaS builders, while evangelizing the Okta Integration Network
  • Build a scalable ISV pipeline by identifying and nurturing new integration opportunities including partnering cross-functionally with Corp Dev, PMM, and field teams to expand our top of funnel
  • Guide ISVs through their integration journey, from discovery and implementation to delivery and maintenance
  • Partner with field teams (PAT, SEs, AEs, TAMs) to drive adoption of strategic products and features within the Auth0 ISV customer segment
  • Synthesize feedback from ISVs, product, and field teams to refine ISV Ecosystem program investments and internal product direction
  • Establish and continuously improve a repeatable and scalable “learn, build, publish” integration lifecycle, leveraging AI tools where appropriate to expand ecosystem impact

Required:

  • 4+ years of experience in developer support, sales engineering, technical account management, partner engineering, or marketplace development
  • Strong understanding of identity and security requirements for enterprise SaaS builders
  • Excellent analytical and communication skills, with the ability to establish credibility and influence both technical and business stakeholders
  • Ability to evaluate software, identify integration opportunities, and engage effectively with product and engineering leaders
  • Passion for learning new technologies and sharing knowledge with the ISV community
  • Adaptability in a dynamic environment with a focus on continuous process improvement

Preferred:

  • Experience nurturing partner or customer relationships in a success-focused role
  • Proficiency in one or more modern programming languages (e.g., Java, C#, Ruby, Python, JavaScript)
  • Domain knowledge in identity and access management (e.g., SAML, OIDC/OAuth, SCIM, SSF, privileged access, API security)

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field

title: Operational Tax, Senior Manager
description:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us. 

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

 

📍London or Remote (UK) | 💰 £94,700 - £111,400 ➕ incentive awards tied to your performance | Benefits | Hear from the team

⭐ About the role

We're looking for a hands-on, detail-oriented and proactive Operational Tax Senior Manager to support the Tax team at Monzo, and our wider Finance and Product teams.

You'll be joining our Tax Team and will be leading on all taxes that touch our customers and their tax reporting, across the UK and Europe. You’ll report into our Tax Governance Lead. 

This role covers all taxes that relate to customer liabilities or customer tax reporting. These are a core part of product design: we make sure we comply with our own obligations, and we make it as easy as possible for customers to comply with theirs. As we launch new products and enter new markets, this is a key area of our tax strategy, and this role gives you the exciting opportunity to own it and work closely with diverse teams across the business. 

🔑 You’ll play a key role by…

  • Owning operational tax: Be Monzo’s subject matter expert on operational tax, advising the business and making sure we meet our obligations as we grow and enter new markets.
  • Leading compliance & controls: Own our operational tax processes and controls across jurisdictions, including BBSI, ISA reporting, FATCA and CRS, Corporate Criminal Offence and CT61s, plus overseas equivalents. Build new processes and controls as our products and markets evolve.
  • Shaping new products: Partner with Product and local market teams from the outset to embed tax into product design, build the right reporting and controls, and pressure-test edge cases.
  • Staying ahead of change: Keep on top of tax laws, regulations and case law across the UK and EU, translating changes into clear actions and helping Monzo prepare for new requirements.
  • Partnering across Monzo: Work closely with Product, Financial Crime, Engineering, Legal, EU Next Markets and Finance to solve problems and support business initiatives from an operational tax perspective.

🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…

  • You’re a qualified accountant and/or qualified tax advisor, or qualified by significant experience.
  • You have significant in-house experience working in Operational Tax.
  • You’re comfortable working relatively autonomously.
  • You’re energetic and are hands-on with your work, tackling whatever needs doing to make things happen. 
  • You have an eye for detail and enjoy working methodically through processes.
  • What we’re doing at Monzo excites you!

🙌 What’s in it for you

💰 £94,700 - £111,400 + incentive awards tied to your performance

📍 We're open to distributed working within the UK, with the expectation of working from the London office on occasional basis.

⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. 

📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.

🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. 

➕ Plus lots more! Read our full list of benefits.

🌈 The application journey has 4 key steps

  • Phone call with Recruiter (30 mins)
  • Initial video call with Tax member (30 mins)
  • Case study video interview with Hiring Manager and Tax member (60 mins)
  • Stakeholder interview (45 mins)

Our average process takes around 3–4 weeks, but we will always work around your availability.

We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out.

title: Fraud Investigator - Customer Protection
description:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. 

The Fraud Investigator (Customer Protection Team) is responsible for handling inbound customer calls for customers with an active fraud alert and account restriction. The team investigates fraud alerts, determining fraud or no fraud utilizing tools and investigative skills, and helping identify emerging fraud trends through data analysis. The team works directly with the customer via phone to gather additional information to help make a fraud determination on their account. 

This role is based in our Lake Mary, Florida or Denver, CO office(s), with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. Hours may vary from Monday through Friday between the hours of 7am to 9pm ET. .

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. 

 

What you’ll do

  • Conduct in-depth and timely investigations on accounts flagged for fraud, across a range of payment vehicles including ACH, Debit Card, Cryptocurrency and Wire Transfers
  • Handling inbound phone calls from users with fraud restrictions and taking those fraud cases to the finish line by applying investigative techniques according to the internal procedures and policies
  • Using critical thinking and pattern detection to discover proactive ways to identify emerging fraud
  • Documenting the rationale and determination for each alert and referring to other teams where necessary
  • Gathering key information from the customer regarding their account as well as applicable documentation. 
  • Communicating with customers next steps and setting expectations. 

What you bring

  • 2+ years experience in fraud investigations including in-depth knowledge of various fraud activities such as Account Takeovers, Identity Theft, Money Mule, and Money Movement Fraud, among others; or, equivalent experience adjacent to fraud investigations.
  • Proactively identify problems and come up with solutions (ability to think outside-the-box)
  • Ability to operate in a fast paced environment
  • Good written and verbal communication, analytical skills, and strong attention to detail
  • Strong interpersonal skills, experience working with cross-functional teams such as product, engineering, legal, compliance, vendor partners, or financial crimes
  • Passionate about mentoring and working with junior fraud investigators and agents to help guide and explore career
  • Ability to work closely with customers to address concerns related to fraud while maintaining a high level of customer service
  • Certified Fraud Examiner (CFE) certification not required but a plus

description:

title: Senior Performance Marketing Manager, Global Paid Social & Mobile UA
description:
Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase, we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. Our Growth Marketing team within the Consumer & Business group scales Coinbase's customer base and revenue through data-driven, full-funnel acquisition strategies across paid channels globally. As Performance Marketing Manager, Global, you'll own our performance marketing program, managing hundreds of millions in ad spend across paid social and mobile channels to drive new user acquisition at or above ROI targets.

 

What you'll do:

  • Own end-to-end global strategy and execution across paid social (Meta, TikTok, Snap, Reddit) and mobile user acquisition (mobile display) to hit aggressive new user acquisition and efficiency targets.
  • Drive a rigorous testing and learning agenda across creatives, audiences, bidding strategies, and app store/landing experiences; translate results into scaled playbooks for global markets.
  • Partner with Data Science and Analytics to design experiments, incrementality tests, and mobile measurement frameworks (MMM, SKAN, MMP-based) that connect paid social and mobile UA performance to downstream business outcomes.
  • Lead platform relationships with ad platforms and mobile measurement partners, aligning on betas, measurement approaches, and joint growth plans to unlock new capabilities.
  • Build and maintain performance dashboards and reporting for paid social and mobile UA spend, with clear visibility by geo, product, and channel; proactively surface insights, risks, and opportunities to leadership.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Product Marketing, Legal, Engineering, Creative, Data Science, and regional teams.

 

Required skills and experience:

  • A minimum of 5+ years of hands-on performance marketing experience, with deep expertise in paid social (Meta, TikTok) and mobile user acquisition in an in-house or agency environment
  • Proven track record owning large-scale paid social and mobile UA budgets and delivering measurable improvements in user acquisition efficiency across multiple channels and markets.
  • Strong technical aptitude and experience leveraging LLMs, no-code/low-code platforms, and automation tools (e.g. Zapier, n8n, Make, Retool) to prototype custom agents and AI-driven workflows that accelerate growth experimentation, optimize operational efficiency, and scale hyper-targeted paid social and mobile campaigns
  • Analytical and experimentation mindset; comfortable with spreadsheets and BI tools (e.g., Looker, Hex, Tableau, Superset) to build and launch tests, interpret results, and make data-grounded decisions.
  • Deep experience with mobile measurement and privacy-aware execution, including SKAN, mobile measurement partners (AppsFlyer, Adjust, Branch), event strategy, and incrementality testing across app and web
  • B2C experience required; fintech, crypto, or high-consideration consumer financial products strongly preferred.
  • Excellent cross-functional collaboration and communication skills, able to synthesize complex performance narratives and influence senior stakeholders with clear recommendations.
  • Highly organized with strong project management skills; able to manage multiple geographies, campaigns, tests, and priorities in parallel while maintaining execution quality
  • Utilize generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

title: Technical Program Manager,  Extensibility
location: Remote in the US, Chicago, Atlanta
description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About our organization

The Growth organization drives Stripe's self-serve growth engine: from a user's first interaction with Stripe through onboarding, activation, and expansion across our products. Growth focuses on building the systems and surfaces that help any user find, understand, and adopt the right set of Stripe products, regardless of how or where they start.

Within Growth, the onboarding program is how new and existing users get to their first successful use of Stripe as quickly and completely as possible. A cohesive onboarding experience is critical to Stripe's ability to convert prospects, activate new products, and compete against increasingly sophisticated alternatives.

Onboarding spans several interconnected surfaces:

  1. Acquisition and intent capture — first-touch experiences that match prospects to the right products and entry points.
  2. Account setup and activation — guided flows that get users live with the right integration shape.
  3. In-product discovery — contextual surfaces that help new and existing users adopt additional products over time.

These surfaces are deeply interdependent, span dozens of cross-functional teams, and directly shape Stripe's new user activation and product attach rates.

What you’ll do

  • We are seeking a product-focused Technical Program Manager to drive Stripe's onboarding programs. This is a high-impact role at the intersection of growth strategy, product management, and cross-organizational program ownership.
  • In this role, you will own one of the most strategically consequential programs in Growth, driving the direction, health, and outcomes of Stripe's onboarding experience end-to-end. 
  • You will set the program strategy in partnership with Growth leadership, holding organizations accountable to the success of the program. 
  • Drive cross-org decisions across DRIs in Growth, Dashboard, Docs, Marketing, and product teams actively resolving the hard, ambiguous integration and ownership questions that fall between team boundaries.
  • Influence and shape product and engineering roadmaps bringing a program-level perspective to team planning cycles, and advocating for cross-cutting investments that no single team will prioritize on their own.

Qualifications

Minimum requirements

  • 5+ years of technical program management experience with demonstrated success in driving complex cross organizational programs.
  • Strong product sense and ability to understand enterprise customer needs
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate with precision and credibility across engineering, product, and executive audiences, translating complex technical trade-offs into strategic decisions, and driving alignment.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead and align cross-functional teams — driving decisions, resolving conflict, and building consensus across organizations with competing priorities
  • Proven track record of successful program delivery in complex technical environments
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • Background in product management or product operations

title: Product Manager - Developer Experience, Bridge
description:
Who we are

About Bridge

We're creating an entirely new payments platform, built with stablecoins, to simplify global money movement. Bridge enables faster, cheaper payments and borderless access to dollars via stablecoins. Through our APIs, businesses can send and receive funds across borders faster and cheaper vs. SWIFT and other fiat-only rails. Our virtual accounts enable international consumers and businesses to easily access, store, and spend US dollars. Our payouts infrastructure enables platforms to disburse USD to anyone globally. We believe many trillions of dollars will move and settle through stablecoin payment rails. Bridge is pulling this future forward.

We have a small team of people who have previously built financial infrastructure at some of the world's leading companies (Coinbase, Stripe, Square, Brex, Upstart, DoorDash, Airbnb), and each and every one of them chose Bridge because they fundamentally believe that stablecoins will be a critical piece of financial infrastructure that allows for the improvement of global money movement.

About the team

Join our Product team to build the systems that make global, programmable money trustworthy at scale. At Bridge, we’re not just improving global payments — we’re reinventing how money moves across borders using stablecoins and modern financial infrastructure.

As a Product Manager for Developer Experience, you'll own the end-to-end developer experience from their first encounter with Bridge to transacting billions of dollars in volume on our platform. You'll work at the intersection of product, engineering, data, and go-to-market to build the self-serve onboarding, developer Dashboard, and activation systems that help any developer build a scaled and successful business with Bridge.

This role is about enabling a developer of any size and stage to build and scale their business successfully on Bridge. 

What you’ll do

Responsibilities

  • Own the end-to-end developer lifecycle and key products, spanning self-serve sign-up, KYB and onboarding, the developer Dashboard, and activation and retention programs.
  • Drive product features from ideation to launch in close collaboration with engineering, design, data, and go-to-market teams.
  • Design and evolve data-driven signals and systems that recognize what a developer needs at each stage and respond automatically with the right nudges, support, and interventions.
  • Define and own the product roadmap that creates a scalable and intuitive experience for every developer to use Bridge’s full suite products.
  • Define and own key developer metrics (e.g. activation rate, time-to-first-transaction, developer retention) to drive business impact.
  • Partner closely with go-to-market and support teams to understand developer feedback and ship improvements rapidly.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

What You’ll Need to Thrive

  • Empathy for users: You’re passionate about uncovering and solving pain points.
  • Deep curiosity: You never stop asking “why” and dig into both qualitative and quantitative data.
  • Owner’s mentality: You tackle challenges head-on and drive solutions with conviction.
  • Collaborative spirit: You work seamlessly with team members but aren’t afraid to make the call when needed.
  • Clarity and simplicity: You translate complex systems into intuitive, straightforward user experiences.
  • Bias for learning: You embrace mistakes as opportunities to grow and improve quickly.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 6–10+ years of product management experience, with exposure to developer platforms, onboarding, and product-led growth.
  • Experience building or owning systems related to onboarding, activation, retention, or self-serve growth.
  • Experience operating across multiple customer segments or go-to-market motions, from self-serve to enterprise.
  • Comfort working with APIs, dashboards, or developer-facing platforms.
  • Experience in fintech, payments, or crypto.

If you’re ready to shape the future of how money moves, we want to hear from you!

title: Business Development Representative II, Enterprise
description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organisations unlock the full value of their data.

Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organisations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.

Fivetran helps organisations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organisations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organisations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.

During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

About the Role

title: GTM Finance Sr. Analyst
description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data. Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on. Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact. During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

About the Role

Fivetran is building data pipelines to power the modern data stack for thousands of companies.

As a Senior Analyst on the GTM Finance team, you’ll operate at the center of revenue strategy — owning mission-critical models, delivering insights that influence executive decisions, and partnering directly with Sales and RevOps leadership.

You will translate sales performance and operating data into actionable insights to help drive forward-looking strategic planning across our new and existing business, optimize investment decisions and scale our sales-led GTM motions.

This is a high-impact role for an analytically rigorous finance professional to build deep expertise in SaaS sales finance.

Our hybrid work model offers a blend of remote flexibility and in-person collaboration, including two days in the office each week to connect and build as a team.

What You’ll Do

  • Sales Capacity and Productivity: Build and maintain sale capacity models supporting decisions on headcount, ramping, productivity, attainment and quota
  • Book-of-Business Planning: Analyze and support revenue planning for the existing customer base, including renewals, expansion, contraction, churn and retention
  • Headcount and Investment Planning: Manage headcount forecast and budget planning, collaborating with Sales leaders, Revenue Operations and Recruiting 
  • Investment ROI: Evaluate the return on sales investments by analyzing incremental headcount, productivity, pipeline generation, bookings, ARR, contribution margin, and payback
  • Forecasting and Annual Planning: Support quarterly forecasts, long-range planning, annual operating plans, target setting, and scenario analysis
  • Performance Analysis: Prepare monthly and quarterly forecast-to-actuals reporting, variance analysis, and performance narratives for Sales and Finance leadership
  • Business Partnering: Work closely with Sales, Revenue Operations, Data, Accounting, and other Finance teams to improve data quality, align on definitions, and deliver decision support
  • Executive and Stakeholder Reporting: Develop clear analyses, dashboards, and presentations that communicate performance, risks, opportunities, and recommended actions

Skills We’re Looking For

  • 3-5 years of FP&A, investment banking, corporate finance, or strategic finance roles
  • Deep familiarity with SaaS metrics, revenue forecasting, and GTM operating models
  • Expert-level modeling skills (Excel/Sheets), and comfort working with BI tools (e.g., Looker); planning systems (Pigment/Anaplan/Adaptive), Salesforce a plus
  • Ability to communicate financial insights clearly to non-finance stakeholders and executives
  • Strong executive presence, attention to detail, and a bias toward action

About the Role

We’re looking for a business-minded  Commercial Legal Counsel, with approximately 5 years of experience drafting and negotiating customer agreements with leading global and domestic organizations.  This legal team member will be a key partner and liaison to other impacted Fivetran departments and stakeholders across the EMEA region.  The ideal candidate is a high impact individual contributor who brings strong legal expertise, sound business judgment, and the ability to operate independently on commercial matters while working closely with senior members of the Commercial Legal Team.

This is a full-time, remote position based out of our Dublin, Ireland office. 

Professional fluency in both English and French is required, as this role will support customers and internal stakeholders across EMEA, including French-speaking markets.

 

Technologies You’ll Use

  • Ironclad, SFDC, AI tool

 

What You’ll Do

  • Review, revise and negotiate commercial contracts with customers and prospects, including customer paper agreements, for the EMEA region 
  • Serve as one of the designated legal contacts on the EMEA commercial legal team to Fivetran’s EMEA enterprise sales team, including sales team education, training and communications related to any changes to customer agreements 
  • Serve as one of the primary legal contacts on the commercial legal team, providing strategic guidance and oversight on contracting, enablement, and process improvement initiatives
  • Help maintain and update commercial legal team playbooks to help drive alignment with internal stakeholders
  • Support key template documents, including periodic revisions and improvements, and help operationalize templates into the contracts management and automation tool 
  • Liaise with Fivetran’s product team to understand how product updates may impact existing or new customer agreements 
  • Contribute to the development and implementation of best practices for commercial contract lifecycle management, ensuring efficient review, negotiation, and approval processes
  • Stay abreast of evolving legal trends and industry best practices in the SaaS and data privacy space, including EU/UK requirements
  • Complete other special projects given your interest areas and the needs of a rapidly scaling company and team

 

Skills We’re Looking For

  • A commercial attorney with approximately 5 years of experience in negotiating commercial contracts at high-growth technology companies, with interest in data and privacy.
  • A negotiator with a solid understanding of global commercial transactions, including experience in drafting, reviewing, and finalizing agreements, such as sales agreements, SaaS and enterprise B2B transactions, and data processing agreements (compliance with GDPR and other data protection laws), including on customer paper.
  • A process-oriented lawyer with an interest in building and optimizing processes and procedures in partnership with legal operations
  • A track record of achieving high-volume, quick turn on execution of agreements constructed to mitigate risk and support revenue growth, including customer paper review
  • A strong communicator with excellent written and verbal skills, able to clearly articulate complex legal concepts to both a technical and non-technical audience
  • High attention to detail, with demonstrated self-initiative that drives a desire for impact and achievement 
  • Qualified solicitor/lawyer (or equivalent) admitted to practice in Ireland, England & Wales, or another European jurisdiction
  • Professional fluency in both English and French is required, including the ability to independently review, draft, and negotiate commercial agreements in both languages. 

 

Bonus Skills​

  • Experience using AI tools (such as Claude or similar) to enhance legal workflow efficiency, including contract review, drafting, and research
  • EU AI Act knowledge
  • Experience negotiating partner contracts

title: Lead Company Operations Manager
description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About the Role

Fivetran + dbt Labs is building data pipelines to power the modern data stack for thousands of companies.

We're looking for a Lead Company Operations Manager to join the COO Office — the team responsible for setting the pulse of the company: developing our strategies, holding leaders accountable for executing them, and taking on the cross-functional work that lacks a clear owner.

This role owns Leadership Operations: the standing forums and rhythm through which NewCo's leadership runs the business. You will own the mechanics behind our board meetings, help run the ELT's operating rhythm and quarterly Strategy Days, and make sure the decisions made in those forums are carried through to closure. Your remit is what happens in the room — forum design, agendas, pre-reads, decision capture, and follow-through — and the calendar of forums, planning cycles, and decision points that connects them.

The work is deliberately diverse. One week you're building the narrative and data behind a board deck with the executive leadership team; the next you're redesigning a cadence that is consuming more executive time than it returns, or scoping a special project that arrived without a brief, an owner, or a definition of done. You'll work directly with stakeholders at every level across Product, GTM, Finance, and Engineering — from individual contributors who own the underlying work to the executives accountable for it — and you'll be expected to bring structure to problems that show up without any.

You'll join a small, central team in the middle of the Fivetran + dbt Labs integration, so expect to build mechanisms that don't exist yet rather than inherit mature ones. Early on, your impact will come mostly from the structure, materials, and follow-through behind our leadership forums, with a clear path to owning more of the live facilitation as you build relationships with the executive team.

This is a full-time position based out of our Denver office. Our hybrid work model offers a blend of remote flexibility and in-person collaboration, including two days in the office each week to connect and build as a team.

This position reports to the Director of Business Operations & Chief of Staff to the COO.

What You'll Do

Executive Rhythm of the Business

  • Own and maintain the integrated calendar of executive forums, planning cycles, and decision points.
  • Improve the rhythm itself: identify cadences that are duplicative, low-signal, or consuming more executive time than they return, and propose changes.
  • Make sure each forum has a clear purpose, owner, input set, and decision output — and that they don't collide or duplicate each other.

Board Meetings

  • Own end-to-end preparation of board materials: build the storyline, partner with Finance and department leaders on the underlying data, and manage review cycles with the ELT.
  • Maintain a reliable source of truth for board and executive reporting metrics so numbers reconcile across Finance, GTM, and Product reporting.
  • Synthesize scattered executive inputs into a single, decision-ready artifact — a doc, model, or deck that moves the conversation forward.
  • Partner with the COO's Executive Assistant, who owns scheduling and logistics, so content and logistics stay in lockstep.

ELT Strategy Days

  • Help run the quarterly ELT Strategy Days: topic selection, agendas, pre-reads, facilitation materials, and clean capture of every decision with a named owner and date.
  • Shape Strategy Days around the priorities most likely to propel the business forward rather than a standing agenda.
  • Carry decisions and action items out of each session, drive them to completion with the accountable ELT member and their department operations team, and bring unresolved items into the next session.

Weekly ELT Meetings

  • Help run the weekly ELT meeting: topic selection, agendas, pre-reads, facilitation materials, and clean capture of every decision with a named owner and date.
  • Close the loop between the weekly meeting and Strategy Days. Track decisions and action items across both, drive them to completion with the accountable ELT member and their department operations team, and bring status and open items back into the next session.
  • Remove blockers rather than just report status, escalate early when something is stuck, and be able to show what measurably changed as a result of these cadences.

SLT Engagements

  • Lead and facilitate recurring engagement with the SLT — VPs and above — to leverage their perspective and influence, and keep them abreast of happenings across the business.

Strategic Initiatives and cross-functional support

Fivetran + dbt Labs is building data pipelines to power the modern data stack for thousands of companies.

title: Lead Company Operations Manager
description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About the Role

Fivetran + dbt Labs is building data pipelines to power the modern data stack for thousands of companies.

We're looking for a Lead Company Operations Manager to join the COO Office — the team responsible for setting the pulse of the company: developing our strategies, holding leaders accountable for executing them, and taking on the cross-functional work that lacks a clear owner.

This role owns Leadership Operations: the standing forums and rhythm through which NewCo's leadership runs the business. You will own the mechanics behind our board meetings, help run the ELT's operating rhythm and quarterly Strategy Days, and make sure the decisions made in those forums are carried through to closure. Your remit is what happens in the room — forum design, agendas, pre-reads, decision capture, and follow-through — and the calendar of forums, planning cycles, and decision points that connects them.

The work is deliberately diverse. One week you're building the narrative and data behind a board deck with the executive leadership team; the next you're redesigning a cadence that is consuming more executive time than it returns, or scoping a special project that arrived without a brief, an owner, or a definition of done. You'll work directly with stakeholders at every level across Product, GTM, Finance, and Engineering — from individual contributors who own the underlying work to the executives accountable for it — and you'll be expected to bring structure to problems that show up without any.

You'll join a small, central team in the middle of the Fivetran + dbt Labs integration, so expect to build mechanisms that don't exist yet rather than inherit mature ones. Early on, your impact will come mostly from the structure, materials, and follow-through behind our leadership forums, with a clear path to owning more of the live facilitation as you build relationships with the executive team.

This is a full-time position based out of our Philadelphia office. Our hybrid work model offers a blend of remote flexibility and in-person collaboration, including two days in the office each week to connect and build as a team.

This position reports to the Director of Business Operations & Chief of Staff to the COO.

What You'll Do

Executive Rhythm of the Business

  • Own and maintain the integrated calendar of executive forums, planning cycles, and decision points.
  • Improve the rhythm itself: identify cadences that are duplicative, low-signal, or consuming more executive time than they return, and propose changes.
  • Make sure each forum has a clear purpose, owner, input set, and decision output — and that they don't collide or duplicate each other.

Board Meetings

  • Own end-to-end preparation of board materials: build the storyline, partner with Finance and department leaders on the underlying data, and manage review cycles with the ELT.
  • Maintain a reliable source of truth for board and executive reporting metrics so numbers reconcile across Finance, GTM, and Product reporting.
  • Synthesize scattered executive inputs into a single, decision-ready artifact — a doc, model, or deck that moves the conversation forward.
  • Partner with the COO's Executive Assistant, who owns scheduling and logistics, so content and logistics stay in lockstep.

ELT Strategy Days

  • Help run the quarterly ELT Strategy Days: topic selection, agendas, pre-reads, facilitation materials, and clean capture of every decision with a named owner and date.
  • Shape Strategy Days around the priorities most likely to propel the business forward rather than a standing agenda.
  • Carry decisions and action items out of each session, drive them to completion with the accountable ELT member and their department operations team, and bring unresolved items into the next session.

Weekly ELT Meetings

  • Help run the weekly ELT meeting: topic selection, agendas, pre-reads, facilitation materials, and clean capture of every decision with a named owner and date.
  • Close the loop between the weekly meeting and Strategy Days. Track decisions and action items across both, drive them to completion with the accountable ELT member and their department operations team, and bring status and open items back into the next session.
  • Remove blockers rather than just report status, escalate early when something is stuck, and be able to show what measurably changed as a result of these cadences.

SLT Engagements

  • Lead and facilitate recurring engagement with the SLT — VPs and above — to leverage their perspective and influence, and keep them abreast of happenings across the business.

Strategic Initiatives and cross-functional support

  • Take on ambiguous, cross-functional initiatives assigned to the COO Office, from initial framing through delivery. Roughly 20% of your capacity is reserved for this unplanned work.
  • Structure new work quickly with a clear charter: problem statement, success measures, decision rights, stakeholders, and timeline.
  • Drive projects to measurable outcomes without formal authority, influencing peers and executives across functions.
  • Transition completed initiatives to a permanent owner with the documentation and mechanisms needed to sustain them.

Skills We're Looking For

  • Proven experience (5+ years) in program management, business operations, strategy, or chief of staff roles, supporting stakeholders at all levels, up to and including senior executives.
  • Demonstrated ownership of executive or board-level forums: you've designed agendas, produced pre-reads, captured decisions, and made follow-through stick.
  • Credible in the room with senior leaders, with the appetite to grow into leading executive forums yourself. Much of the face-to-face facilitation is driven by the Chief of Staff today; you'll build toward taking more of it on.
  • Systems thinker — you look for the underlying mechanism, not the one-off fix, and you design processes others can run without you.
  • Owner mentality with a high tolerance for ambiguity; you take unclear requests, define the problem, and drive to a positive outcome without waiting to be told how.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication, with a track record of tailoring the same message for an individual contributor, a department leader, and a board audience.
  • Comfortable with data — able to work in spreadsheets, run ad hoc analysis, pressure-test numbers from other teams, and translate results into a clear recommendation.
  • Experience with program management tools and methodologies, and a demonstrated ability to run multiple concurrent work streams without losing detail.

Required AI competencies

  • Use conversational AI systems (like Claude, ChatGPT, and internal chatbots) to research, author, review, and synthesize operational artifacts such as board narratives, process documents, and executive updates.
  • Build repeatable AI workflows — prompts, skills, or agents — rather than treating AI as a one-off drafting tool.
  • Evaluate AI output critically, including knowing when the task calls for human judgment instead.

Bonus Skills

  • Experience preparing board materials at a private, VC- or PE-backed company.
  • Experience supporting post-merger integration or another period of significant organizational change.
  • Experience standing up or rationalizing an executive operating cadence from scratch.
  • Familiarity with BI tooling (Looker) and basic SQL.
  • Light scripting or low-code automation experience for building internal tools.
  • Prior experience in B2B SaaS, with working fluency in ARR, NRR, pipeline, and margin.

About the Role

Fivetran is building data pipelines to power the modern data stack for thousands of companies.

We’re looking for a talented Sales Engineering Specialist - Security to join our global sales engineering specialist team. As a Sales Engineering Specialist focused on Security, you will work closely with our sales and field sales engineering teams to satisfy customers’ security needs. You will be responsible for providing timely responses to security questionnaires, engaging in customer-facing infosec calls, and collaborating with our internal SRE and Product teams focused on ensuring Fivetran’s platform security.

Technologies You’ll Use

In this role, you will be expected to have a strong understanding of the following technologies:

  • Fivetran's data integration platform, deployment methods, and security features
  • Cloud computing platforms such as AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud Platform
  • Security technologies such as firewalls, intrusion detection systems, data loss prevention systems, and encryption
  • Containerization and orchestration technologies such as Kubernetes and Docker, and familiarity with hybrid and self-hosted deployment models
  • Security and Data Privacy Compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI, HIPAA, HITRUST and GDPR

What You’ll Do

  • Support our sales and field sales engineering teams with deep technical knowledge and understanding of Fivetran’s internal security operations, related platform features, and the security domain
  • Deliver timely and accurate responses to prospect and customer security questionnaires utilizing internal tooling
  • Work with Legal and AppSec to maintain internal libraries for use in security questionnaires
  • Lead documentation and internal enablement efforts, helping to scale our specialist knowledge to the entire department
  • Work closely with Fivetran’s Product and Engineering teams to ensure alignment of our solutions to our customer needs
  • Engage directly with prospects and customers on security architecture reviews and compliance discussions, with increasing ownership over time
  • Stay up-to-date on the latest technologies and trends in the security domain

Skills We’re Looking For

  • 3+ years as a security administrator, backend engineer, field CISO, or IT services within an enterprise or similarly complex environment
  • Extensive expertise with modern cloud and on-premise network architectures, connectivity mechanisms (SSH, Reverse SSH, VPN, PrivateLink), and data security.
  • Ability to effectively communicate Fivetran’s detailed security posture and influence security audiences at all levels
  • Passion for data, security, analytics, and a philosophy of using technology to help solve business problems, including experience with using generative AI to accelerate and scale day-to-day workflows 
  • Experience with trust center management platforms and security questionnaire automation software
  • Curiosity to learn and assimilate technical information quickly, enthusiasm to share and teach others. 
  • Familiarity with programming languages such as Java, SQL, and Python is a plus

About This Role

We’re hiring a Senior Data Analyst to support our People organization, using data to help Fivetran attract, develop, engage, and retain exceptional talent as we scale. You’ll work across the employee lifecycle — from recruiting and workforce planning to employee experience, learning and development, performance, and retention — turning complex people data into insights that shape how we build and support our teams.

 

 

This is a high-impact, highly cross-functional role for someone who enjoys operating at the intersection of data, people, and strategy. You’ll partner closely with leaders across People, Recruiting, Finance, and the broader business to answer important organizational questions, develop scalable analytical frameworks, and improve how decisions are made.

 

This is a full-time, flexible hybrid position based out of our Oakland, CA or NYC, NY office. Our hybrid work model offers a blend of remote flexibility and in-person collaboration. There is no mandate on the number of days required but we encourage employees to come in every week to collaborate.

 

Technologies You’ll Use

  • SQL (BigQuery / Snowflake)
  • dbt / dbt State
  • Looker / LookML
  • Sigma / Hex / Google Sheets
  • Claude Code / Codex
  • HRIS, ATS, and other People systems and data sources

What You’ll Do

  • Define and own our core People metrics. Establish clear definitions and reporting across areas such as headcount, hiring, retention, organizational health, employee experience, and talent development.
  • Build scalable analytical products. Create canonical datasets, models, and self-service tools and dashboards that enable People teams and leaders to answer important questions quickly and consistently.
  • Serve as a trusted thought partner. Translate analyses into clear narratives and recommendations for audiences ranging from functional operators to senior executive leadership. Work closely with our Engineers to improve Fivetran's own HRIS and ATS connectors.
  • Set a high bar for responsible People Analytics. Help establish strong practices around data quality, integrity, governance, privacy, appropriate access, and the responsible use of sensitive employee data.
  • Turn people data into decisions. Analyze complex and disparate datasets to identify trends, surface opportunities, and provide actionable recommendations to People leaders and business stakeholders.
  • Shape our analytics culture. Mentor other analysts and partners, establish analytical best practices, and help People teams develop stronger data fluency and decision-making habits.


Skills We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience in analytics, data science, business intelligence, or a related analytical role
  • Advanced proficiency in SQL and data modeling, with experience working across large, complex datasets
  • Experience using Looker, Tableau, Sigma, or similar business intelligence and visualization tools
  • Strong analytical judgment and a track record of translating ambiguous business questions into structured analyses and actionable recommendations
  • Exceptional attention to detail and a high bar for data quality, analytical rigor, and reproducibility
  • Excellent communication and data storytelling skills; you can make complex findings intuitive and help decision-makers understand not just what is happening, but why it matters and what to do next
  • Comfort operating in ambiguity, developing hypotheses, and owning analytical problems end-to-end
  • Strong cross-functional instincts and the ability to build trusted relationships with both technical and non-technical partners
  • A builder mindset: you look beyond answering one-off questions and create frameworks, datasets, and tools that make future decisions faster and better
  • Passion for using data to improve how organizations attract, develop, and support their people
  • Experience using analytics to support key business decisions, preferably at a high-growth, SaaS, or B2B product company


Bonus Skills

  • Experience in People Analytics, workforce analytics, recruiting analytics, HR strategy, or another People-related analytical function
  • Familiarity with HRIS, ATS, performance management, engagement, or learning systems

About the Role

Fivetran + dbt is building data pipelines to power the modern data stack for thousands of companies.

We’re looking for a high-performance, experienced hands-on technical program manager(TPM) in the security domain to be part of an Engineering team. In this role, you will be responsible for leading and managing security-related initiatives across the organization. It involves collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure the successful planning, execution, and delivery of security programs. The TPM will act as a bridge between technical teams and business stakeholders, ensuring alignment with organizational goals while mitigating security risks.

The work is very diverse. Fivetran is a multi-cloud environment operating on AWS, GCP, and Azure. You will help select security tools, implement improvements within our environments, and assist in developing new processes to increase our security posture.


This is a full-time position based out of our Oakland, CA office. Our hybrid work model offers a blend of remote flexibility and in-person collaboration, including two days in the office each week to connect and build as a team.

Technologies You’ll Use

Bash, Python, JS, BigQuery, Looker, Sigma, Azure, AWS, GCP, Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes, Github, Buildkite, SonarQube, Grafana, Prisma, Synk, Signal Sciences, AI Tools

What You’ll Do

  • This is the primary person in engineering responsible for executing the security vulnerability management program for engineering, including infrastructure, code, and dependency vulnerabilities.
  • Collaborate with Security and Engineering teams to ensure vulnerabilities are identified, prioritized, and patched. Provide technical oversight and accountability to ensure the effective delivery of security fixes.
  • Enhance processes by evaluating tools, recommending improvements, and driving automation for faster resolution.
  • Usage of AI in defining the roadmap for a proactive security approach based on risk assessment/rating
  • Running the Dependency management and image hardening programs
  • Using AI to contribute to the remediation of code and infrastructure vulnerabilities
  • Establish and lead a code scanning program in collaboration with infrastructure, engineering, and security teams to ensure seamless integration and sustainable security practices.
  • Dedicate up to 20% of the time to assessing business systems to identify vulnerabilities and compliance gaps proactively. Develop a scanning and detection plan and establish policies and standards for internal data access tools to improve overall system security.
  • Advocate for tools and solutions that support shift-left strategies, driving early integration of security and testing in the development lifecycle.

Skills We’re Looking For

  • Over 5 years of experience in technical program management with a strong focus on security engineering, vulnerability management, cloud security, and application security.
  • Proficient in applying program management methodologies, tools, and best practices to deliver complex security initiatives.
  • Exceptional skills in prioritization, organization, and multitasking to manage multiple programs effectively.
  • Proven ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams, including product teams, SRE/QE engineers, and developers, to embed a security-first mindset into workflows and practices.
  • Deep understanding of key security domains, including application/infrastructure security, data privacy, threat modeling, vulnerability management, and secure software development lifecycle (SDLC).
  • Strong grasp of security concepts and principles, including network security, encryption, authentication, and authorization.
  • Hands-on experience with SAST/DAST tools, agent-based firewalls, IDS/IPS technologies, and automation tools for security orchestration. Experience with scripting languages for automating security processes.
  • Proficient in researching and validating vulnerabilities while proposing effective remediation or mitigation strategies.
  • Strong familiarity with OWASP principles and best practices for securing web applications, including the OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities and Application Security Verification Standard (ASVS)
  • Up-to-date knowledge of market trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in cloud security
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills to address security challenges, coupled with the ability to influence and collaborate effectively with engineering teams in enhancing security measures and mitigating vulnerabilities in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

We’re hiring a Billing & Collections Analyst to own day-to-day billing operations, cash application and collections support for our India team. This is a hands-on, operational role focused on invoice generation, payment application, reconciliations, dispute management and AR reporting. You’ll partner with Order Management, Deal Desk, Revenue Accounting and Collections to ensure invoices are accurate, payments are applied correctly, and customer queries are resolved quickly — helping improve cash velocity and reduce billing exceptions.

This is a full-time position based out of our Bangalore office.

Technologies You’ll Use

  • NetSuite (or equivalent ERP), Salesforce/CPQ, Avalara, payment gateway tools, Google Sheets, Jira, Zendesk, and integration platforms (Celigo or similar), Claude, Notion.

What You’ll Do

  • Execute billing cycles and ensure timely, accurate invoice creation, distribution and correction in the ERP.
  • Manage billing adjustments, credit/debit memos, chargebacks and maintain billing logs and audit trails.
  • Apply customer payments (electronic, wire, checks, cards), reconcile payments to invoices and bank statements, and maintain high cash application accuracy.
  • Own periodic AR sub-ledger reconciliations and support month-end and quarter-end close tasks.
  • Support collections activity: aging analysis, dunning, customer follow-up, payment arrangements and escalation of delinquent accounts.
  • Investigate and manage customer billing disputes; coordinate cross-functional resolution with Sales, Deal Desk, Order Management and Revenue Accounting.
  • Develop and maintain AR reporting and KPIs (DSO, aging buckets, unapplied cash, dispute backlog) and deliver regular updates to stakeholders.
  • Lead and participate in UAT for NetSuite and SFDC changes, payment gateway integrations, and billing/process enhancements; author UAT scripts and document defects.
  • Maintain strong internal controls, SOPs, runbooks and documentation to support audits and ensure segregation of duties.
  • Proactively identify process improvements and partner with technical and business teams to reduce manual work, improve accuracy and tighten financial controls.
  • Support knowledge transfer and documentation activities to ensure team continuity and operational readiness.

Skills We’re Looking For

  • 3+ years’ hands-on experience in billing, accounts receivable, cash application and collections (shared services or corporate finance experience preferred).
  • Practical experience with ERP/billing systems (NetSuite, SAP, Oracle or similar).
  • Strong spreadsheet skills (Google Sheets / Excel — pivot tables, reconciliations).
  • Experience performing bank reconciliations and AR sub-ledger reconciliations.
  • Comfortable authoring and executing UAT test scripts for finance systems and tracking system defects.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and customer service skills; strong attention to detail and a controls mindset.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work across global teams.

Bonus Skills​

  • Experience with SQL or working with transactional data.
  • Exposure to payment gateway integrations and billing middleware (Celigo, iPaaS) or automation tools.
  • Prior experience working with BPO providers or participating in cross-geography knowledge transfer programs.
  • Comfortable building and auditing agentic workflows

About the Role

Fivetran is building data pipelines to power the modern data stack for thousands of companies. We’re looking for a Senior Manager, Accounts Receivable & Billing to lead and scale our global billing and AR operations during a period of significant business transformation. This role will be responsible for strengthening billing operations, financial and operational controls, credit review processes, billing data governance, month-end readiness, and team execution across a complex global Order-to-Cash environment. The Senior Manager will play a critical role in preparing the organization for the integration of Fivetran and dbt Labs into a unified operating model, including readiness for the planned February 1, 2027 cutover. This person will partner closely with Order Management, Revenue Accounting, Accounting, GTM Systems, Product, Finance, Deal Desk, Sales Operations, Legal, and Collections to ensure billing data and processes are accurate, scalable, well controlled, and operationally ready for the future state.

The role will also lead the support model into the India Center of Excellence, including hiring, onboarding, knowledge transfer, process documentation, and ongoing team development. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can move comfortably between detailed billing and accounting issues and broader process design, controls, automation, systems integration, and team leadership.

This is a full-time position based out of our Oakland office. Our hybrid work model offers a blend of remote flexibility and in-person collaboration, including two days in the office each week to connect and build as a team.

Technologies You’ll Use

NetSuite, Salesforce, billing and payment platforms, SQL, Excel, Google Sheets, AI and automation tools, workflow management tools, RPA, APIs, and financial reporting and reconciliation tools.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead end-to-end billing operations, including invoice generation, delivery, amendments, credits, corrections, reconciliations, exception management, and customer-specific billing requirements.
  • Design, implement, document, and monitor billing and AR controls, including approval requirements, reconciliations, audit evidence, change controls, and exception-management procedures.
  • Establish and operationalize customer credit review and credit-check processes, including approval thresholds, documentation standards, credit limits, and escalation procedures in partnership with Finance and GTM stakeholders.
  • Lead billing and AR operational readiness for monthly and quarterly close, ensuring activities, reconciliations, adjustments, and supporting schedules are completed accurately and on time.
  • Drive billing-data readiness for the February 1, 2027 NewCo cutover, including data requirements, mapping, validation, reconciliation, testing, controls, exception handling, and operational readiness.
  • Partner with Order Management, GTM Systems, Product, Revenue, and Accounting to identify and resolve upstream data and process issues that create downstream billing errors or manual work.
  • Develop and scale AI-enabled and automated workflows that move recurring billing, reconciliation, and finance activities toward exception-based management while maintaining appropriate controls and auditability.
  • Recruit, onboard, and develop team members within the India Center of Excellence and lead the transition of responsibilities.
  • Create and maintain SOPs, runbooks, process maps, control documentation, testing procedures, close checklists, and training materials that enable consistent execution and reduce key-person dependency.
  • Provide concise leadership reporting on billing health, controls, operational risks, cutover dependencies, unresolved issues, and readiness milestones.

Skills We’re Looking For

  • 8+ years of progressive experience in accounts receivable, billing, order-to-cash, accounting operations, revenue operations, or related finance functions, including significant experience in a complex B2B or SaaS environment.
  • 3+ years of direct people-management experience, with demonstrated success building and developing distributed or global teams.
  • Deep understanding of billing operations, month-end close, reconciliations, financial controls, audit requirements, and customer credit-risk processes.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and implementing scalable operational controls, process improvements, and governance frameworks.
  • Strong systems and data capabilities, including experience with ERP and billing platforms such as NetSuite, Salesforce, Zuora, Oracle, SAP, or similar, with advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills and SQL proficiency preferred.
  • Experience leading significant transformation initiatives such as finance-system implementations, process migrations, M&A integration, shared-services transitions, or operating-model redesign.
  • Demonstrated ability to use AI, automation, workflow tools, RPA, APIs, or related technologies to reduce manual work while creating appropriate monitoring, documentation, and human-review controls.

Bonus Skills​

  • Experience integrating billing or finance operations following a merger or acquisition.
  • Experience establishing or expanding an India-based Finance Center of Excellence.
  • Experience working in a SOX or similarly controlled financial environment.
  • Experience with AI-enabled finance workflows, automated reconciliations, or exception-based operating models.

  • Identify opportunities to eliminate manual work, accelerate the close, improve data quality, strengthen controls, and standardize processes.
  • Lead cross-functional initiatives involving accounting systems, financial data, integrations, workflow automation, and process redesign.
  • Champion the responsible adoption of AI across Accounting, identifying and implementing high-value use cases that improve productivity, quality, and employee experience.
  • Build AI capabilities across the team through training, experimentation, and best-practice sharing while establishing appropriate governance and human oversight.
  • Establish metrics to measure improvements in close performance, automation, productivity, and quality.

Build and Lead a High-Performing Team

  • Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing accounting team capable of operating effectively in a fast-growing SaaS/Data environment.
  • Develop future leaders by increasing ownership and building stronger accounting, technology, and business capabilities across the team.
  • Foster a culture of continuous improvement where the team challenges existing processes and embraces technology, automation, and new ways of working.
  • Balance operational excellence with transformation, ensuring the organization executes reliably while continuously improving how work gets done.

What We're Looking For

  • 10+ years of progressive accounting experience, including leadership of corporate or GL accounting functions within a public company or similarly complex environment.
  • 4+ years of people leadership experience; experience managing managers preferred.
  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field
  • Deep knowledge of U.S. GAAP, financial close processes, internal controls, and accounting operations.
  • Experience within a SaaS, software, technology, or data business strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated success leading meaningful Accounting or Finance transformation initiatives.
  • Strong systems orientation with experience improving ERP, close management, reconciliation, workflow, or other Finance technology platforms.
  • Strong understanding of AI and automation and an ability to translate emerging capabilities into practical accounting applications.
  • Excellent project management, change leadership, and executive communication skills.
  • Ability to move seamlessly between strategy and execution and influence stakeholders across Finance and the broader organization.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role goes beyond delivering an accurate close. You will help build an accounting organization that is increasingly automated, intelligent, scalable, and forward-looking.
You will create a more efficient and predictable close, reduce reliance on manual processes, embed AI and automation into how the team operates, and build a strong leadership bench. Ultimately, this role will help define what a modern Accounting organization should look like in an AI-enabled SaaS/Data company.

About the Role

Fivetran is building data pipelines to power the modern data stack for thousands of companies.

We’re looking for a self-motivated, detail-oriented, and technically proficient Technical Accounting & Financial Reporting Senior Manager. This individual will play a key role in supporting complex accounting matters, building scalable processes, collaborating cross-functionally, and contributing to a strong internal control and reporting environment that meets the standards of a sophisticated, fast-growing SaaS company.

This is a full-time position based out of our Denver office. Our hybrid work model offers a blend of remote flexibility and in-person collaboration, including two days in the office each week to connect and build as a team.

What You’ll Do

  • Research, analyze, and document technical accounting issues and memos and prepare calculations to support accounting conclusions and facilitate external audit reviews in accordance with US GAAP, including but not limited to ASC 718 (Stock-Based Compensation), ASC 350-40 (Capitalized Software), ASC 340 (Capitalized Commissions), ASC 805 (Business Combinations), ASC 842 (Leases), and ASC 480 (Debt & Equity).
  • Develop and maintain accounting policies and procedures, and lead implementation of significant changes.
  • Work with external valuation specialists to ensure complex transaction valuations are completed accurately and on time, including managing inputs and reviewing deliverables for 409A valuations, intangible asset valuations, and equity award valuations.
  • Collaborate with teams across Accounting Operations, Engineering, Finance, Legal, HR, and other departments to ensure technical guidance is consistently operationalized and understood.
  • Support initiatives to enhance external reporting readiness, including complex accounting topics, disclosures, and process improvements.
  • Help design and implement efficient, SOX-compliant accounting processes and internal controls to support organizational growth.
